confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are the strongest: Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere and Expatistan agree roughly, though some snapshots are dated 2022 to 2024, and I converted VND at about 26,000 per USD. Beer and wine are low confidence. Beer sources conflict widely, and the wine anchor is a glass estimate that relies on a 2022 bottle-price proxy and the beer relationship. Cocktail prices come from one promotional guide site. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no listings or booking pages were checked. July is peak domestic tourist season in Da Lat, so room rates may run higher than the estimates. FX is the 16 October 2026 RBA observation taken from search-result snippets of the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the page or table F11.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Da Lat-specific crowdsourced price data (Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan) and a 2026 Da Lat cocktail guide, converted to USD. Beer and wine lean on local price relationships. Da Lat is priced below Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City tourist districts and above rural Vietnam. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Vietnamese highland tourist towns.
